verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents several ways to drive the product in natural language. Rico answers plain-language analytics questions such as "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?". The official MCP server lets AI assistants manage apps, Products, Entitlements and Offerings without the dashboard. The AI Toolkit lets a user's coding agent set up subscriptions, and paywalls can be generated and edited from an AI prompt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and evidence that the native assistant (Rico) can execute operational commands rather than only answer analytics questions, since configuration changes rely on an external AI assistant via MCP.
